text:
maya: morning async — what I did: landed kernel slotting patch, ran microbatch perf, wrote a small reproducer for KV eviction.
chris: nice, any numbers from the perf run?
maya: short bench dump:
```
bench: model=gpt-small seq=512 batches=64 p50=12ms p95=62ms p99=120ms
kv: hit=84% eviction-spikes ~95s under steady load
```
alex: p95 62ms on seq512 is higher than our goal (<50ms). what was per-GPU batch size?
maya: per-GPU batch=8, overall batch=64. slotting changed dynamic 16->8 which reduced coalescing. saw long tails from request coalescing.
sasha: any blockers preventing rollout?
maya: no blockers for the patch itself, but want a quick CR on slot allocator -> PR #482. also want to verify prefetch behaviour since eviction correlated with prefetch bursts.
alex: @maya i can take a look at PR later today.
chris: can we repro with prefetch disabled? suspect prefetch race is causing KV churn.
maya: queued a bench run with prefetch off — benchbot will run on canary.
benchbot: queued run id=2023-08-31-171 on canary pool (prefetch=false).
benchbot: run complete -> results:
```
p50=11ms p95=48ms p99=98ms kv_hit=91% prefetch=false
```
sasha: nice, that's a clear improvement. points to prefetch path causing extra eviction/load.
alex: action items: maya -> add telemetry counter for prefetch misses, and spin a 24h canary with prefetch disabled.
maya: on it. I'll add a counter (+1 new metric: runtime.prefetch.miss) and open a canary config. CR link: https://git/internal/pr/482
chris: quick request — can you post the exact local repro command so I can run it in dev?
maya: repro command:
```bash
./tools/run_bench --model gpt-small --seq 512 --batch 64 --slots dynamic --prefetch false
```
alex: thanks — i'll run it and comment on the PR if i see anything suspicious.
maya: TL;DR: slotting patch ready, benches improved when prefetch disabled, will add telemetry + canary. no blockers for rollout after CR and canary check.
sasha: :thumbsup:
benchbot: deployed canary config 482-canary-1 to pool-a (start=1718994380).
